notes.title: Paralives, the long-anticipated indie Sims-like, finally announces an early access release date, adding to 2025's already packed life sim line-up
notes.notes: It's been almost exactly six years since developer Alex Massé (of PewDiePie's Tuber Simulator fame) announced his indie life sim Paralives; now, the game finally has an early access release date, courtesy of its appearance at last night's PC Gaming Show at Summer Game Fest. And, as promised, it's going to be coming out this year – although you're going to have to wait until December 8 to get your hands on this painterly Sims-like. Read more

notes.title: PARALIVES EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE TRAILER IS OUT NOW 🗣️📢
notes.notes:
Hi, Alex here for an extremely exciting post! We’re finally ready to announce a release date for Paralives’ Early Access, which will be December 8, 2025, and we made a brand new trailer for the occasion! We also have many details to share regarding the game’s release, so please read on!


[previewyoutube="uvGPV6qQuQM;full"][/previewyoutube]
🎥 A Brand New Paralives Trailer

We’re happy to reveal a new trailer for Paralives! You can watch it at the top of the post or on Youtube. We made this trailer to announce the release date of the game and to showcase parts of the Paralives town and its citizens. We got the opportunity to present it at the PC Gaming Show, which happened today! We are so excited to have been part of this event and we hope that more people will now look forward to Paralives.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/e965964f00318200f11d8b6b367a18bb18b5bfe4.png"]

🥳 Early Access Release Date Announced

Paralives will come out on Steam in Early Access on December 8, 2025! 🎈🥳🎉🎊


As it will be Early Access, players will probably find that the game needs more content. Our goal with Early Access is to provide a first enjoyable experience that has room to grow, so that we can collect feedback from players and improve the game. We’re looking forward to jumping into this next exciting phase of Paralives’ development!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/274161843e4df95b9222ac5cc9955cf7b28e6988.png"]
🎨 New Key Art and New Logo


To celebrate the release date announcement, we have a brand new key art to use on our Steam page. A huge thank you to Mario Miravalles who did this amazing illustration!


Also, we’ve changed our logo! We’re a bit sad to say goodbye to our old one but we really felt like updating it so that it better represents the mood of the game. The new hand-written aspect shows that the game is all about creativity and also, it gives a more personal vibe, just like the stories you will be able to tailor for your Parafolks.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/67447c97348e731a25541c68f5cde90f1b158571.png"]

💵 Pricing


Paralives will cost $39.99 USD when it comes out in Early Access this December. After the Early Access phase, when the game launches its 1.0 version, we plan to increase the price of the game. Our goal here is to thank early players with a smaller price tag as core gameplay features are still being improved, bugs are being fixed, and content is being added.


As a reminder, during Early Access and after, the game will only ever get free updates and expansions and will never have any paid DLCs. This decision stems from the fact that, as life simulation fans ourselves, we believe that players deserve a complete experience when purchasing a game. Since we are a small independent team, the sales from the base game will be enough to sustain the development of exciting new features and content for Paralives.



📝 Features and Content: What to Expect At Launch


For those who are curious about what to expect from Paralives at launch in terms of features, here’s an overview. Please note that upcoming features are not listed in priority order. Also, after the game has completed its Early Access development phase, we plan to add even more features and content!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/8583f62ccd51d1248f916ac682f3d0e971c817a9.jpg"]


As you can see, the game already has a considerable number of features! We’re eager to improve these and add even more during Early Access to make this life simulation game as complete and as good as possible following the feedback that we will receive from you, the players.



As a reminder, you can look at our monthly development recaps and consult the fully detailed roadmap listing all features in the game and what’s still to come.


I hope you are as excited as we are for what’s to come and we can’t wait for you to jump into Paralives on December 8th. We’re sincerely grateful for all your support over the years and for making Paralives possible!


See you soon for more news and updates on the game!


Alex and the team


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/072d57528d9692ff6c7806decd1d6e01519c7d42.png"]

notes.title: Highly anticipated indie Sims 4 rival Paralives sets early access release window for 2025
notes.notes: Paralives, the independently-developed life simulation game suspected to be coming for The Sims 4's crown, has received a long-awaited news update on when we might really get to play it. The development team led by Alex Massé released a seven-minute gameplay video and accompanying blog post last night, which also addressed their plans for DLC (the elephant in the simulated living room), and ended with the announcement that an early access release is planned for an as-yet-unspecified date in 2025.Paralives was announced back in 2019 and currently pulls in £27.5K/$33K monthly via Massé's Patreon, which is amazing when you consider that these seven minutes are the most footage we've ever seen in one go of the game's all-important Live Mode; to say nothing of the fact that this is the first time the team have let slip a hint of a release window for the game. Clearly there's plenty of appetite among players for a serious challenger to go toe-to-toe with EA's behemoth Sims franchise.In case there was any doubt remaining, Paralives is clearly squaring up to The Sims with yesterday's announcement that all updates and expansions will be free, including those released after the game's eventual V1.0 launch out of early access, and that the game will never branch out into paid DLC. (Quick reminder that a full complement of The Sims 4's DLC would currently set you back over a grand, with no signs of new content releases slowing down; while collecting every little add-on available for The Sims 3 honest-to-goodness costs as much as outright purchasing a family home in some parts of Wales.) Read more

notes.title: Paralives heats up the race to be the next Sims with early access release in 2025, confirms no paid DLC
notes.notes:
After years without a new The Sims game, it seems like three are likely to land in fairly close proximity - sort of, anyway. We know that Paradox’s ambitious competitor Life By You will arrive this June (assuming no more delays), while EA’s own free-to-play evolution of the OG life-sim series - currently codenamed Project Rene rather than The Sims 5 - is probably still a while off yet. Dropping somewhere in the middle will be Paralives, the promising Patreon-funded up-and-comer led by indie dev Alex Massé, which has been given a fresh look and confirmation of a release date sometime next year.
 Read more

notes.title: Sims 4 rival Paralives sets release window, "will never have paid DLC"
notes.notes:
With The Sims 4 now almost a decade old, one of the most exciting rivals to EA's long-standing champion of the life sim genre has outlined its plans for launch. Paralives is now coming in 2025, and in a new gameplay overview video the team behind the Patreon-funded upcoming PC game, helmed by team lead Alex Massé, states that it will never put out paid DLC after launch, committing to "only free expansions."

notes.title: Paralives release date, early access, gameplay, and latest news
notes.notes:
When is the Paralives release date? This upcoming life sim has been likened to The Sims, and it's easy to see why. With cute outfits, tons of items, an extensive character creator, build mode, and extra features we wish were in The Sims, there's a lot to look forward to.
Paralives is an ambitious project, but we already know a fair bit about what's heading to this simulation game. What started as a Patreon project by lone developer Alex Massé in 2019 has developed into a full-blown life sim game. Though the studio relies on community pledges to keep the indie game in development, the official website is great at keeping the community updated with progress and what to expect next.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The Full Paralives Development Roadmap + April Dev Update

The roadmap link:
➡️➡️➡️ paralives.notion.site/f138c4f6cb234604be16fe4198d17f51

On the roadmap, you might notice that there will be an Early Access for the game. We still have some way to go before the release and we are not ready to announce a release date or an estimated price yet but keep an eye out for more news and game development updates! notes.title: 📢 Video Update: Skin color wheel, tattoo placement and more!
notes.notes:
'Tis the season of giving dev updates! 🎁⛄️

Didn’t we tell you we’d be back soon with a crunchy dev update? Today’s the day! 
We are happy to unveil different ways to customize your characters in Paralives using the in-game character creation tool called the Paramaker. We really wanted to offer an extra level of customization with freehand tattoo placement and scaling, heterochromia, 2 color wheels for skin tones… We are also introducing new characters (townies)!
We’ll stop talking and let you enjoy the video instead! ;)

[previewyoutube=saPMQS1jquc;full][/previewyoutube]

Please let us know in the comment section what you think and what feature you are most looking forward to using in the Paramaker! We do read those even if we don’t reply very often.

This is our last dev update of the year so we would like to take this opportunity to wish you happy holidays! May the new year bring you a new favourite game, whichever it may be!

Cheers,
The Paralives Team
